text: Subsequent pilot work in humans reported good agreement in muscle mass estimates between D 3 -creatine dilution and MRI ( r = .87) (13). The method showed less bias than DXA-derived estimates, which overestimated muscle mass by approximately 2-fold compared to MRI. However, the study was carried out in a hospital setting with a 5-day period of continuous urine collection; hence, its applicability to free-living populations is extremely limited.
book: Science and Development of Muscle Hypertrophy
chapter: Chapter 3: The Measurement of Muscle Hypertrophy
